reply:
🧭 Tambaya mai fadi: ina tsara binciken…
---
📚 Ina karanta takardu 11: partner reports, plans, policies, fiscal documents, surveys and statistics… (har zuwa minti 3)
---
✍️ Ina rubuta taƙaitawa daga alƙaluma 27 da aka tabbatar…
---
A jihar Sokoto, takardu sun nuna gibi a fannoni da yawa: daga cikin cibiyoyi 259 da suka cancanci tantancewa an samu nasarar tantance 232 (89.6%) a rahoton 2026 (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 30), amma akwai gibi na cibiyoyi 44 na EmONC cikakku idan aka kwatanta da abin da WHO ta gindaya na 70 a kowace mutane 500,000 a 2025 (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 47) da gibi na 40 na Basic EmONC.
Takardu sun gindaya a matsayin target gyara da sanya ma'aikata a cibiyoyin primary 92 a fadin kananan hukumomi 23 a 2025 (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 37) da kuma zama cikin manyan wurare 5 na yawon buɗe ido na lafiya a Najeriya nan da 2030 (Sokoto State 9-Point SMART Agenda, p. 3).

*Health facilities and infrastructure*
Takardu sun nuna gibi biyu masu alaƙa da ka'ida: gibi na cibiyoyi 44 na EmONC cikakku idan aka kwatanta da target na WHO na 70 a kowace mutane 500,000 a 2025 (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 47) da gibi na 40 na Basic EmONC.
A daidai lokacin, daga cikin cibiyoyi 259 da suka cancanci tantancewa an tantance 232 (89.6%) a rahoton 2026 (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 30).
Rahoton 2020 na MSP ya kara bayyana gibi na 207 cibiyoyi da ke bukatar gyara don cimma ka'ida (Sokoto State Minimum Service Package for Primary Health Care…, p. 7) da kuma 26 da ba su wanzu ba kwata-kwata kuma ake bukatar ginawa.
---
*Health workforce and staffing*
Jimillar ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya da aka kidaya a fadin jihar a rahoton 2020 ta kai 11,202 (Sokoto State Minimum Service Package for Primary Health Care…, p. 6), amma adadin Nurse/Midwives a sahun gaba ya kasance 78.
---
*Healthcare financing, funding and spending*
Kasafin kudin lafiya na jihar ya karu daga ₦15.81 billion a 2018 (State Health Resource Optimization Plan (ROP) to Improve Healthcare…, p. 6) zuwa ₦29.6 billion a 2022.
---
*Health outcomes and disease burden*
Matsakaicin yawan yara a kowace mace a 2024 ya kasance 5.4 (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 37).
---
*Health governance, policy and strategic plans*
Takardu sun gindaya target na gyarawa da sanya ma'aikata a cibiyoyin primary 92 a fadin kananan hukumomi 23 a karkashin Safe Deliveries Initiative a 2025 (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 37) da kuma target na zama cikin manyan wurare 5 na yawon buɗe ido na lafiya a Najeriya nan da 2030 a karkashin Healthcare pillar na 9-Point SMART Agenda (Sokoto State 9-Point SMART Agenda, p. 3).
Shirye-shiryen dabarun sun hada da HSSB da ke da enablers 3 a tsakanin 2023-2026 (Sokoto State 2025 Health Sector-wide Annual Operational Plan, p. 16) da kuma SWAp Core Priorities guda 13 a rahoton 2025 (Sokoto State 2025 Health Sector-wide Annual Operational Plan, p. 23).
